_doc: Night Lord skill definitions (spec #383, one marked region per ticket): NL6 #405 Flash Jump (mobility; its entry is the first one below, the region NL6 owns; later tickets append after it); NL7 #406 moves Lucky Seven and Drain here from skills/thief.json and adds Avenger and Triple Throw; NL8 #407 Ninja Storm and Ninja Ambush; NL9 #408 Shadow Meso; NL10 #409 Shadow Partner. Until a key is defined in a file it is inert: never offered or learned. A key may be defined in one file only (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4), NL7 #406 moved Lucky Seven and Drain here. NL2 #401 defined none.
_nl8_region: NL8 #407 owns ninja_storm and ninja_ambush (the two entries below, kept together); other tickets append their entries beside them, never inside.

flash_jump.name: Flash Jump
flash_jump.desc: Press its skill key in the air to flash sideways. Once per jump.

text.desc: Press the Flash Jump key while airborne, with an arrow key, to flash sideways without losing height. It works once per jump, and the higher your level the farther you go.

flash_jump._flash_jump: Tier A: WZ 4111006 (20 levels) holds only mpCon (not modelled) and the Use sound; the String text says the jump grows with the level. Tier C (spec #383 M14, NL6 #405): the distance table (140 px at rank 1 to 280 px at rank 20, linear over the ranks, GAME_DESIGN 7.92), the 0.3 s repeat delay, once per airborne period, the bot's 70 px threat distance. The rank is the round's level through balance.mobility_rank_levels (1 at Lv1, 10 at Lv20, 20 from Lv40), never a card; the node has no art, so the presentation is a code-drawn ghost trail.

shadow_meso.name: Shadow Meso
shadow_meso.desc: Throws a heavy bag of mesos at the nearest monster. It hits harder the more of the meso charge you hold, and costs no mesos.

text.desc: Throws a heavy bag of mesos at the nearest monster. It hits harder the more of the meso charge you hold, and costs no mesos.
text.h: Damage {damage_percent}% of your weapon damage, costs no mesos

shadow_meso._tier: Tier A: the WZ has no damage for 4111004, only moneyCon 135 -> 570 (the average mesos per throw), x 50, prop 1 -> 10 and the three art tiers (the level nodes' ball / hit UOLs change at levels 11 and 21), Use and Hit sounds. Tier C (#408, GAME_DESIGN 7.94.4): damage% = moneyCon x 0.6 (damage_basis), no mesos spent (ruling D7: moneyCon is kept for the balance pass), +10% damage per held meso-charge pip on top of the meter's own +3% (meter.read_per_unit), swingO1 (the claw's own stance: the node has no action, and shoot1 hides the claw), nearest auto-cast, 3.0 s cooldown, 300 px range, 650 px/s, 10 px radius, no pierce, 0.6 s hold, the echo class, rarity bonuses. x, prop and bulletCount are not modelled (recorded as unused; count is pinned to 1). Untuned.

ninja_storm.name: Ninja Storm
ninja_storm.desc: Throws a ring of stars around you that hurts the monsters near you and shoves them away.

text.desc: Hurt up to 6 monsters around you and shove them away from you. Needs a monster in the storm's box.
text.h: Damage {damage}%, up to {mob_count|monster|monsters}; {prop}% chance each to be pushed back.

ninja_storm._rarity: Tier C: first-pass NL8 #407 bonuses (spec #383): Ninja Arts and Wide Storm are flavour names (the skill has no passive of its own); Second Wave adds a line on each struck monster; Legendary shares the Unique's id (and its repeat counter) plus damage x1.2; Mastery repeats shrink x0.8. GAME_DESIGN 7.94.8.
ninja_storm._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 4121008 damage 42 to 80 % (rank 1 = level 4: 48 %), prop 42 to 100 (read as the push's success rate: rank 1 48 %), mobCount 6, the symmetric box +-100 / 150 / 200 by (-70, 30) (levels 1 / 11 / 21), the ninjastorm action, effect (16 frames), hit/0 and mob art, the Use and Hit sounds. Tier C: the 4.0 s cooldown, min_targets 1, the 0.6 s action hold, the push distances 100 / 200 / 300 px by rank (the String.wz text's 100 / 200 / 300 px for levels 1-10 / 11-20 / 21-30 mapped to the eight ranks; there is no WZ field), `knockback.effect` (the `mob` art once on each pushed monster), the default 30-level rank table, no weapon gate. GAME_DESIGN 7.94.8.

ninja_ambush.name: Ninja Ambush
ninja_ambush.desc: Hides ninjas where you stand; they strike the monsters in the zone every second.

text.desc: Leave an ambush at your feet. Its ninjas strike up to 6 monsters in the zone every second. Needs a monster in the zone's box.
text.h: Damage {damage}% per strike, up to {mob_count|monster|monsters}, for {time} sec.

ninja_ambush._rarity: Tier C: first-pass NL8 #407 bonuses (spec #383): Ninja Arts and Wide Ambush are flavour names; Ambush Squad adds two monsters to every strike (`count` raises mobCount); Legendary shares the Unique's id plus damage x1.2; Mastery repeats shrink x0.8. GAME_DESIGN 7.94.8.
ninja_ambush._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 4121004 damage 62 to 100 % per strike (rank 1 = level 4: 68 %), mobCount 6, time 4 / 8 / 12 s, the symmetric box +-110 -> +-200 by (-130, 70) (rank 1 +-120), the alert3 action, the 19-frame effect, the mob0 strike art on each struck monster and the Use sound. Equal to 4221004 at all 30 levels. Tier C: the 14 s cooldown (a 12 s zone never overlaps itself), min_targets 1, `ground.strike` {interval 1.0, first_delay 0.3} anchored at the cast, the 0.6 s action hold, no tile art (the effect plays once at the cast, the strikes bring `mob0`), the default 30-level rank table, no weapon gate; Shadow Shifter level 5 (the WZ req) is ignored. GAME_DESIGN 7.94.8.

lucky_seven.name: Lucky Seven
lucky_seven.desc: Throws two stars at nearby monsters, using LUK regardless of Claw Mastery.
lucky_seven._tier: Tier A: WZ weapon 47, bulletCount 2, damage, mpCon, effect and CharLevel hit art; no ball node, so ammo_shot uses the current star. Tier B: LUK x5.0/x2.5 formula ignoring mastery (v83-facts 5). Tier C: nearest auto-cast, 250px base claw reach, cooldown 1s, shoot1 held 0.6s, speed 600px/s, radius 8px, no base pierce; untuned. NL7 #406 (GAME_DESIGN 7.94.6): ported from thief.json with the default 20-level rank table (ranks 1/4/8 read levels 3/10/20), the claw's own swingO1 stance instead of shoot1 (the claw vanishes in shoot1, ROSTER_PLAN D10, tier C), `echo` attack class, rarity bonuses.

drain.name: Drain
drain.desc: Throws a star and absorbs part of its damage as HP, capped at half your MaxHP and the monster's MaxHP.
drain._tier: Tier A: weapon 47, damage, mpCon, x healing percent, effect, lowercase use sound; v83 text caps healing at character MaxHP/2 and target MaxHP. Tier C: nearest auto-cast, one star, 250px range, 1s cooldown, speed 600px/s, radius 8px, no base pierce, shoot1 held 0.6s; untuned. Whole healing points truncate. NL7 #406 (GAME_DESIGN 7.94.6): ported from thief.json with the default 30-level rank table (ranks 1/4/8 read levels 4/15/30), the claw's own swingO1 stance instead of shoot1 (ROSTER_PLAN D10, tier C), `echo` attack class, rarity bonuses.

text.desc: Throws a star and absorbs part of its damage as HP, capped at half your MaxHP and the monster's MaxHP.
text.h: Damage {damage}%, absorb {x}% of damage as HP.

avenger.name: Avenger
avenger.desc: Hurls one giant star that pierces a line of monsters.
avenger._tier: Tier A: WZ damage 65..180%, mobCount 4..6, action avenger, the 14-frame caster effect, the 72x72 rotating ball and the Use sound; the WZ has no range, no lt/rb and no hit art, and bulletConsume 3 is not modelled (endless ammo). Tier C (#406, GAME_DESIGN 7.94.6): the eight survivor ranks (levels 4..30 through the 30-level table), nearest auto-cast with its own ball (no ammo sprite), 3.5s cooldown, 350px range, 700px/s, 14px radius, `pierce_field` mobCount (the star strikes mobCount monsters, so it pierces mobCount - 1) with no falloff, 0.6s held stance, echo class skill, rarity bonuses (the Epic grants stunning_avenger). Untuned.

triple_throw.name: Triple Throw
triple_throw.desc: Throws three stars at one monster.
triple_throw._tier: Tier A: WZ damage 102..150% per star, bulletCount 3, weapon 47, hit/0 and the 6-frame effect, Use and Hit sounds; the WZ node has no action. Tier C (#406, GAME_DESIGN 7.94.6): the eight survivor ranks (levels 4..30), `cast.focus` (all three stars at the nearest monster, a scheduled boss first), 2.5s cooldown, 300px range, 650px/s, 8px radius, no pierce, the claw's own swingO1 stance held 0.6s (shoot1 hides the claw, ROSTER_PLAN D10), echo class skill, rarity bonuses. Untuned.

shadow_partner.name: Shadow Partner
shadow_partner.desc: Calls a shadow clone that follows you and throws every star skill again a moment later.

text.desc: Calls a shadow clone that follows you. A moment after you throw a star skill, the clone throws it again for part of its damage: more for Lucky Seven and Drain, less for the heavier star skills. Zones and the Ninja Storm do not echo.
text.h: Echoes Lucky Seven and Drain at {x}% damage and Avenger, Triple Throw and Shadow Meso at {y}%, for {time} sec.

shadow_partner._tier: Tier A: Skill.wz 4111002 x 20..80 (the echo percent of an `attack` star: Lucky Seven, Drain), y 21..50 (a `skill` star), time 60..180 s, action alert, the 16-frame effect, the 11-frame effect0 behind the avatar, the Use sound, and the `special` shadow frames (34 action sets, 98 canvases with origins and no delay). Tier C (#409, GAME_DESIGN 7.94.7, spec #383 M11): the 50 s cooldown (the 60 s minimum lifetime covers it), the echo delay 0.25 s, follow speed 200 px/s, follow distance 55 px, teleport distance 600 px, clone spacing 40 px, the 0.8 s alert hold, no standalone item cost (the Summoning Rock is not modelled), damage "none" (a clone never strikes; the echo carries the owner's stars), the default 30-level rank table, rarity bonuses (Shadow Power scales the echo percent through the damage modifier; Twin Shadow is a second clone). Untuned.
